messages:
zara: hey everyone, day 1 and trying to get my ducks in a row. three quick things: who to contact for a badge pick-up, who approves repo and GPU requests, and what's the short owner map for escalation (so i don't page the wrong team)?

henry: welcome zara! :wave: facilities handles badges (facilities@redwood.com). DM me if you need same-day kiosk print and i'll nudge them. you'll be added to the group `redwood-building-access`.

claire: for repo/GPU access it's eng-infra. easiest flow is the helper in #eng-infra. example snippet to paste:```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/serving role:developer reason:"onboarding: need commit"```
for GPUs:```/infra-request resource:gpu-pool-1 quota:1 reason:"day-1 testing"```
tag @claire for review and paste the returned AR/IR into your onboarding Jira.

zara: perfect. is there a tiny owners cheat-sheet i can pin on my desk? i've seen multiple docs.

miguel: canonical list is the service-ownership handbook (pinned in #product) but short cheat: runtime -> eng-runtime; serving infra -> eng-infra; api & gateway -> eng-platform; observability -> eng-sre; modelops -> eng-ml. for customer-facing regressions include support@redwood.com. i'll DM you a one-page snapshot with names/handles.

zara: thanks. concrete scenario: if a model publish finishes but routing still points to an old version and customers see stale completions, who do i page first?

miguel: page eng-runtime first (they own model routing/version pinning). if logs show infra problems (OOMs, pod evictions) eng-infra joins. if error rates spike or customers are impacted, bring in eng-sre + support@redwood.com. typical flow: triage in #eng-runtime, then oncall if it's not resolved.

henry: small tip: run noisy experiments in staging. if you must test in prod, DM the oncall channel and mark the test window in the runbook to avoid waking people. docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/alerting-guidelines

oncall-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-7744 (repo:redwood-inference/serving) - reviewer: claire - status: pending.

zara: i'll add AR-7744 to my ONBOARD ticket. last q: who should be cc'd for multi-team publish pipeline failures?

miguel: cc eng-runtime, eng-infra, eng-ml, and eng-sre. incident lead will coordinate; include support@redwood.com for customer comms.

zara: awesome, this cleared up a lot. i'll follow up if things get stuck. thanks all!
